summary: Inventiva S.A. filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing that the last patient completed the final 72-week visit in the NATiV3 Phase 3 clinical trial of lanifibranor for MASH, with 1,009 patients in the main cohort and 410 in the exploratory cohort. Topline results are expected in Q4 2026, with regulatory submission anticipated in H1 2027 and a potential U.S. launch in 2028. This is a routine clinical trial progress update, not a special situation. No deal terms, board actions, or strategic events are involved. Watch for upcoming topline data release.
